newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Rubber futures ended narrowly mixed in moderate trade on some late buying and selling interest, brokers said on Wednesday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked up slightly across the board on some short-covering following the yen's steep fall against the U.S. dollar.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh incentives. But prices were narrowly mixed in the afternoon as some speculative buying and selling emerged. Japanese prices were higher today but had little impact on the market here. Volume was moderare," a local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, March RSS3 fell 1.25 cents to 117.75 U.S. cents a kg.
April RSS1 eased 0.25 cent to 170.00 Singapore cents (US$1.21) a kg.
June TSR20 rose 0.25 cent to 168.00 Singapore cents (US$1.20) a kg.
